newsitem.title: USA: Rival to buy certain assets of Dazey Corp.
newsitem.headline: Rival to buy certain assets of Dazey Corp.

text.p: Appliance manufacturer Rival Co said Thursday it agreed to buy certain assets of Dazey Corp, including inventory, tooling, machinery and equipment to manufacture electric kitchen products.
Terms of the transaction, expected to close the first week of January 1997, were not disclosed.
Rival chairman Thomas Manning said, "Dazey's products will fill a void in Rival's kitchen electrics business unit and will increase our plant's utilization."
He said the deal "is expected to increase profitability of this business unit in the second half of our fiscal year."
Revenues of the kitchen electrics products will be about $25 million in calendar 1996, Rival said.
